svg.aria-label: A recorded cad-agent study of a steel L-bracket's inside corner, meshed finer step by step from 2 mm to 0.25 mm: sharp, the peak stress keeps rising; with an R1.5 fillet it settles and converge() passes it
svg.title: A recorded cad-agent study of a steel L-bracket's inside corner, meshed finer step by step from 2 mm to 0.25 mm: sharp, the peak stress keeps rising; with an R1.5 fillet it settles and converge() passes it
svg.desc: Recorded with cad-agent 0.7.0 (commit e0e3bb3) on gmsh 4.15.2 with OpenCASCADE 7.8.1, Linux x86_64, on 2026-11-01. Each step is Study(refine=...) at the inside corner, solved and checked with converge(). Linear-elastic FEA: a converged peak does not prove that a part holds.
svg.text: Mesh convergence at an inside corner: a recorded run
steel L-bracket, 100 N on its free leg; refine= halves the elements at the corner each step

g.text: the whole part meshed at that size, no refine=
Williams (1952): a sharp corner's peak ~ r^−0.46
step 1 of 4: the 2 mm mesh, no refine=: 389 tets sharp, 561 filleted
step 2 of 4: refine= to 1 mm at the corner: 595 tets sharp, 566 filleted; the whole part meshed at 1 mm: 1,832 tets sharp, 1,877 filleted
step 3 of 4: refine= to 0.5 mm at the corner: 1,233 tets sharp, 1,174 filleted; the whole part meshed at 0.5 mm: 11,829 tets sharp, 11,873 filleted
step 4 of 4: refine= to 0.25 mm at the corner: 4,781 tets sharp, 4,129 filleted
sharp: ×1.35 per halving (Williams: ×1.37); it never settles, and converge() never passes it
R1.5 fillet: within 3.4 % over all 4 steps; converge() passes it once the mesh resolves it

svg.text: A recorded run of cad-agent 0.7.0: gmsh 4.15.2, OpenCASCADE 7.8.1, Linux x86_64, 2026-11-01.
Linear-elastic FEA: a converged peak is a better number, not proof that the part holds.
